title: b7z9.35(a): Rust gateway — wire tunnel_auth into dispatch + egress forwarding path
description: Child of b7z9.35 (spec 06-security.md:703-705, 727-807). lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs is exported (lib.rs:20) and library-tested (tests/tunnel_auth_vectors.rs, vectors test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json) but gateway.rs never uses it. Wire: (1) the tunnel-auth permit/deny check into the egress decapsulation/forwarding path (gateway.rs mesh-to-internet direction — drop unauthorized tunnels before forwarding, computing route_hash from the Source-Route Header); (2) the POST /.well-known/tunnel-auth resource (COSE_Sign1 alg -65537) registration in the gateway's CoAP dispatch. Mind the permit()/deny() 204/403 mapping convention (C tunnel_auth.c:24-33 analog). Tests: extend tunnel_auth_vectors.rs with the wired-path cases.
close_reason: Wired spec 06-security 8.11 tunnel authorization into the Rust gateway. (1) Data plane: authorize_tunnel_egress in the mesh-to-upstream path (ingest_mesh_frame_at_superframe) — surveys the SRH via lichen-node's now-pub survey_routing_headers, reconstructs the route from the consumed grid + outer dst, calls authorize_decapsulation; permits decapsulate-and-forward, all else (in-transit SRH, non-tunnel SRH, malformed, unauthorized, expired, C-parity scoped src/dst) drops fail-closed. (2) Control plane: POST /.well-known/tunnel-auth branch in dispatch_runtime_gcp after OSCORE decryption, accept_post with the trust-pinned peer key; 2.04/4.03/4.05 per the C permit/deny convention (categories log-only). Table pinned to the gateway's own DODAG-root IID (always-self-root type; follow-up bead filed for non-root egress re-point + root triggers). Tests: 13 new wired-path cases in tunnel_auth_vectors.rs (18/18 pass); full lichen-gateway 359+1 pass, 1 pre-existing failure (runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim — reproduced on unmodified HEAD, evidence commented on l1qw.16.2). Reviews: 3 passes round 1 (kimi-k3) — 1 correctness finding (fail-open dst scope), FIXED to exact C parity (unsafe/loopback/multicast/link-local/mesh dst; unsafe/link-local src) with 2 new scoped tests; round 2 security PASS, correctness + edge passes timed out in opencode run twice (25min each) and were completed by me per the worker-loop escape hatch — no further findings. Follow-up bead created for root re-point/triggers.
